text:
maria: heads-up: seeing rapid Gi1/0/17 link flaps on ToR-17 (eu-west-2 rack43) since 08:12 UTC. TX errors + drops increasing, a few dedicated allocations preempted.
liam: ack. any BGP adj churn or just link flaps?
maria: only LINK up/down messages in syslog: '%LINK-3-UPDOWN: Interface Gi1/0/17 changed state to down' repeated. no BGP loss.
josh: visible impact: ~6 dedicated instances with p95 tail jumps, 3 preemptions so far. SLO alerts fired.
anya: we have a soft-quarantine/fallback-egress flow but nothing that triggers from ToR syslog. can infra auto-tag allocations on the rack to steer to fallback?
maria: proposal: syslog -> stream -> detector lambda -> allocator-tagging (egress_quarantine=tor-17, ttl=300s) -> egress-proxy honors tag and routes to fallback gw. prevents preemptions at cost of bandwidth.
liam: +1 but preserve opt-outs for strict dedicated customers and add billing tag so cost shows up. canary first.
netops: prefer infra path (no ToR config change). we can also prepare a route-map if needed but would need change window.
josh: fallback headroom in eu-west-2 ~25-30%. canary plan: 3 low-priority tenants for 10m at 22:00 UTC, track preemptions, p95/p99, tx_drops. I'll reserve capacity.
anya: allocator-annotate should skip allocations with annotation 'dedicated:strict=true'.
sre-bot: runbook updated: 'tor-flap egress-quarantine' added. Play: detect -> tag -> monitor 10m -> untag -> escalate if repeating.
liam: action items: maria build detector + tests, anya validate allocator hook, netops prep proxy filter, josh run canary. add metrics: infra.egress_quarantine.applied{tor="tor-17"} and billing tag 'egress_quarantine=true'.
maria: will open PR with lambda/parser and include metric emit + test harness. posting canary link when scheduled. closing thread unless further flaps.
